title: BA1/226/2006 of BUDHDHA SINGH Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
Dated: Nainital the July 19, 2006
Criminal Misc. Application No. ______ of 2006
In
Criminal Bail Application No. 226 of 2006
Order on the bail application of accused
CRIMINAL SIDE
Budhdha Singh S/o Harnam Singh
R/o village Itabba
P.S. Bajpur
District U. S. Nagar ....Applicant
Versus
State of Uttaranchal ...Opposite Party
Arising out case crime No.2115 of 2005
Under Sections 420, 120B IPC
P.S. Bajpur
District U.S. Nagar
Hon'ble B.C. Kandpal, J.
Param Jeet Singh was issued notice by this Court
vide order dated 17.05.2006 to show cause as to why the
proceedings under the Contempt of Court not be initiated
against him.
2. Param Jeet Singh appeared before this Court on
19.05.2006 and this Court framed the charges against him
which read as follows:-
CHARGE
You- Param Jeet Singh S/o Sri Buddha Singh, R/o Itabba, P.S. Bajpur,
District U.S. Nagar are charged as follows:-
That you on 03.01.2006 moved a Bail Application No.15/2006
(Budha Singh S/o Harnam Vs. State) before this Court in case
crime No.2115/2005 u/s 420, 120B IPC, P.S. Bajpur, District
U.S. Nagar. In that bail application, you have filed your

affidavit which was sworn on 11.12.2005. Thereafter, the said
bail application No.15/2006 was taken up on several dates i.e.
04.01.06, 12.01.06, 18.01.16, 07.02.06, 01.03.06 & 01.05.06
etc. Meanwhile, another Bail Application bearing No.226/2006
was filed before this Court in Case Crime No.2115/2005 u/s
420, 120B IPC, P.S. Bajpur, District U.S. Nagar during the
pendency of first bail application and in that bail application
you have filed wrong affidavit sworn on 09.03.2006 that it is a
first bail application in respect of case crime No.2115/2005 u/s
420, 120B IPC, P.S. Bajpur, District U.S. Nagar.
 You have filed the successive bail application without
waiting the disposal of the first bail application. In this way,
you have tried to misguide the Court. Therefore, you have
obstructed the administration of justice amounting to contempt
of Court which is punishable under Article 215 of the
Constitution of India.
AND I hereby direct that you be tried by the Court with
the aforesaid charge.
(J.C.S. Rawat J.)
Judge,
High Court of Uttaranchal
Dt. 19.05.2006"
3. Today, Param Jeet Singh along with his counsel Sri
Pankaj Purohit is present before the Court. I heard Sri Pankaj
Purohit, learned counsel for the contemnor and perused the
reply submitted by him.
4. The record reveals that contemnor - Param Jeet
Singh has given false affidavits before this court concealing the
material facts that the successive bail application, concealing
the existence of the first bail application, was filed without
waiting the disposal of the first bail application. The

contemnor has therefore committed a grave offence by duping
the Court and has also tried to misguide the Court. Any
wrong statement/version given before the Court of concealing
the material fact is indicative of this fact that the person who
is doing the mischief has no respect with regard to the majesty
of Court. The contemnor, therefore, obstructed the
administration justice, which certainly amounts to Contempt
of Court punishable under Article 215 of the Constitution of
India.
5. Keeping in view the gravity of the offence committed
by the contemnor, although I propose to award the deterrent
punishment to the contemnor but in view of the fact that he
has tendered unconditional apology and has assured the
Court that this type of act will not be repeated by him in
future, I punish the contemnor for a penalty of Rs. 5,000/-.
6. The contemnor is punished for the charges levelled
against him and is accordingly imposed a penalty of Rs.
5,000/-.
7. Learned counsel for the contemnor undertakes
before the Court that the penalty of Rs. 5,000/- imposed
against the contemnor shall be deposited in the Cash Section
of the High Court today.
8. With the aforesaid observations, the notice issued
against the contemnor is hereby withdrawn.
(B.C. Kandpal, J.)
19.07.2006
ASWAL
